items.why: AMD climbs as traders weigh the Nvidia CEO exit, per CNBC live updates.
Volatility is up as stocks slide on Nvidia troubles, per Bloomberg's markets wrap.
Nvidia stock plunges after CEO Jensen Huang resigned, per WSJ and NYT live updates.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: S&P futures are down 0.24% and Nasdaq futures are down 0.40%, with the 10-year yield up 2.14% to 5.11%.
summary: Stocks are mixed this afternoon, with futures slightly lower and the VIX jumping. Nvidia is down more than 5% after CEO Jensen Huang resigned, while AMD jumps 6% and bitcoin and gold slide.
